scope: MEAS: independent numerical, published bar-map, source/report and visual review; not aural review or certification of every historical orchestration detail.

report.finding: The report matches recomputed gates, complete unrepeated order, source identity, corrected final chord and actual 16-page pack. It explicitly retains the comparatively low harmonic similarity, acoustic/scoring uncertainty, disputed attribution and absence of aural review rather than treating numerical timing as proof of instrumentation.

barMap.finding: All 8295 note indices resolve, durations are positive and bar times strictly increase. Index.json is byte-identical to the independently reviewed Nikisch pack; all 16 SVG trees also match after consistent piece-specific DOM-id prefix renaming. The five derived boxes therefore correspond to the same individually inspected printed all-orchestra rest measures, not an invented final bar. Listening cues use seconds rather than structured bar references.

overlays.finding: The previous early final-C false positive is resolved: 388.274 s is the last separate closing chord. No gross additional repeat, cut or pitch shift identified in the 17 inspected windows, including all requested weak-harmonic regions. Weak bass fundamentals do not by themselves demonstrate either bass substitution or unchanged scoring. Final written hold is not a measured release.

source.encoder: Stelios Samelis; LilyPond 2.16.2 adaptation by Johannes Heinecke

version.finding: Complete first movement, bars 1–502 once, without the exposition repeat; the extended oboe cadenza remains bar 268. Source clarinet/horn transpositions and the established −12 double-bass correction are retained. Main melodic/harmonic order corresponds in the inspected material; exact acoustic-session doubling/scoring is not independently established. Named source voices are not separated recorded stems.
version.physicalPerformingEdition: Unknown; the B&H encoding is not claimed as the Odeon performers’ actual edition, and the recording’s disputed conductor/date attribution is not resolved by this alignment.

limitations: MEAS: No aural review, build or browser integration check was performed by VerS. This pass concerns the stated provisional timing/source-map gates and absence of an identified gross mismatch, not complete historical orchestration authentication.
